parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_kanban_boards (
    board_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'project',
    columns_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '["Backlog", "To Do", "In Progress", "Review", "Done"]'::jsonb,
    file_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_kanban_cards (
    card_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    board_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    column_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT DEFAULT '',
    priority VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'Medium',
    due_date VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT '',
    tags VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '',
    completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    position INT DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_expenses (
    expense_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    tx_date VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    currency VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'INR',
    category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    payment_mode VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'UPI / Card',
    project_tag VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Personal',
    notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_budgets (
    category VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    monthly_limit_inr NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 15000,
    monthly_limit_cad NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 500,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_job_dossiers (
    job_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
    company VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    stage VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Applied',
    location VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '',
    compensation VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '',
    portal VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'LinkedIn',
    job_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
    interview_notes_md TEXT DEFAULT '',
    prep_checklist_json JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    next_action VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '',
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_notes (
    note_id VARCHAR(160) PRIMARY KEY,
    folder VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    tags VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '',
    content_md TEXT NOT NULL,
    pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE obsidian_notes
  ALTER COLUMN note_id TYPE VARCHAR(160),
  ALTER COLUMN folder TYPE VARCHAR(255),
  ALTER COLUMN title TYPE VARCHAR(500),
  ALTER COLUMN file_path TYPE VARCHAR(500),
  ALTER COLUMN tags TYPE VARCHAR(500);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS obsidian_flashcards (
    card_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    deck VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'Education',
    question TEXT NOT NULL,
    answer TEXT NOT NULL,
    interval_days INT DEFAULT 1,
    ease_factor NUMERIC(4,2) DEFAULT 2.50,
    repetitions INT DEFAULT 0,
    due_date VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    last_reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Strip any numeric prefixes (00_..06_) from folders, file_paths, titles, and decks
UPDATE obsidian_notes
SET folder = REGEXP_REPLACE(folder, '^[0-9]+_', ''),
    file_path = REGEXP_REPLACE(file_path, '^[0-9]+_', ''),
    title = REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(title, '\s*\([0-9]+_[A-Za-z_]+\)$', ''), '^00_', '')
WHERE folder ~ '^[0-9]+_' OR file_path ~ '^[0-9]+_' OR title ~ '\([0-9]+_' OR title ~ '^00_';

UPDATE obsidian_flashcards
SET deck = REGEXP_REPLACE(deck, '^[0-9]+_', '')
WHERE deck ~ '^[0-9]+_';

INSERT INTO obsidian_kanban_boards (board_id, title, category, columns_json, file_path)
VALUES
  ('brd-projects', 'Work & Projects Kanban', 'work', '["Backlog", "To Do", "In Progress", "Review", "Done"]'::jsonb, 'Projects/Work_And_Projects_Kanban.md'),
  ('brd-education', 'Education & Learning Kanban', 'learning', '["Queued", "Studying Now", "Practice / Notes", "Completed"]'::jsonb, 'Education/Education_Roadmap_Kanban.md'),
  ('brd-business', 'Business Ideas & Ventures Kanban', 'project', '["Raw Ideas", "Researching", "Validating", "Building", "Launched"]'::jsonb, 'Business_Ideas/Business_Ideas_Kanban.md'),
  ('brd-loulou', 'LouLou & Luxe Kanban', 'project', '["Backlog", "To Do", "In Progress", "QA & Review", "Live / Done"]'::jsonb, 'LouLou_And_Luxe/LouLou_And_Luxe_Kanban.md')
ON CONFLICT (board_id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  file_path = EXCLUDED.file_path;

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_kanban_boards ORDER BY title ASC) t) AS boards,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_kanban_cards ORDER BY position ASC, updated_at DESC) t) AS cards,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_expenses ORDER BY tx_date DESC, updated_at DESC) t) AS expenses,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_budgets ORDER BY category ASC) t) AS budgets,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_job_dossiers ORDER BY updated_at DESC) t) AS jobs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_notes ORDER BY folder ASC, pinned DESC, updated_at DESC) t) AS notes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM obsidian_flashcards ORDER BY due_date ASC) t) AS flashcards;
